Mauritius.Statistics_Mauritius_Census: 2022 Census Volume III, Table G1 and Appendix IV
geography_findings: Table G1 lists 9 Mauritius Island administrative districts and subdivides them into municipal wards/village council areas.
Table G1 lists Rodrigues separately and identifies its six local regions; Appendix IV lists localities under each of the six regions.
Table G1 includes Agalega with 330 residents; published census tabulations do not provide island-by-island feature geometry.
St Brandon/saint Brandon census reporting notes no permanent residents; do not infer nonexistence of physical land.
Mauritius.interpretation: Nine Mauritius Island districts + Rodrigues + Agalega + St Brandon explains the mixed canonical label “Districts and Outer Islands of Mauritius”; ADM tier number is not a homogeneous role.

physical_screen.interpretation: A coarse independent physical-land screening lead only. Non-detection is not proof of absence, especially reefs, rocks, low islands and scale mismatch.

method_limits: Geometry comparison uses EPSG:6933 equal-area overlays; validity repairs are ephemeral copies for comparison only; no source or atlas geometry is edited.
5% symmetric-difference threshold is an investigation triage threshold, not an accuracy tolerance or boundary-correction rule.
Census counts establish named administrative statistical hierarchy, not point/settlement location or physical land completeness.
No political sovereignty or historical ownership attribute is treated as a physical-geography observation.
Antarctica is excluded; ATF-5919 is an Indian Ocean feature.

settlement_disposition.Madagascar: Exact complete statistical row crosswalk through fokontany exists, but lacks coordinates; fokontany are not automatically individual settlements. 2026 COD-AB geometry remains an administrative source. Follow-up #632.

settlement_disposition.Mauritius: 2022 national Census Volume III G1 identifies 9 island districts, wards/VCAs, Rodrigues and six local regions; Appendix IV lists 310 Rodrigues locality names. These are not an exhaustive geocoded settlement inventory for all assigned district footprints. Follow-up #633.
settlement_disposition.Comoros: OCHA lower ADM hierarchy plus incomplete HOTOSM/OSM feature screen; official geocoded gazetteer unresolved. Follow-up #634.
